history.title: The island remembers
history.summary: Vex survived 6m 45s. Twelve strangers built a society, and scarcity tested every bond.

chapters.title: 01 · The first connections
chapters.text: Kairo traded food to Lyra for medicine. Sage traded food to Rune for medicine. 38 more events followed.

chapters.title: 02 · A changing world
chapters.text: The shrinking safe zone transformed plentiful space into contested ground.

chapters.title: 03 · The cost of trust
chapters.text: Iris stole food from Lyra and was caught. Pax stole food from Onyx without being noticed. 8 more events followed.

chapters.title: 04 · The final encounters
chapters.text: Vex hit Echo for 14 damage. Vex hit Echo for 9 damage. 6 more events followed.
